text:
ana: Kestrel POC request — they want a short dedicated commit test. baseline 400 A100-hr/mo + ability to burst up to ~2,000 A100-hrs over a 14-day POC window. Asking for a temporary burst discount and an explicit cap to avoid bill shock. cc @liam @naveen

naveen: can you paste workload profile (qps, seq len, concurrency, token budget) so i can map to estimated GPU-hours?

ana: sorry typo, ana here. profile below:
```
workload: chat summarization
avg seq len: 512 tokens
avg request tokens: ~1500
avg qps: 12 (baseline)
peak concurrency: ~60
baseline est: 400 A100-hr/mo
POC spike: ~2,000 A100-hrs total over 14 days
```

naveen: ok this matches — main ask is burst cap + discounted burst rate for POC. Without cap they could rack up big burst charges.

liam: from a deals perspective we have a POC playbook. typical offer: 25-30% off committed base + temporary burst discount with a hard cap. For Kestrel i'd propose: 20% off burst rate up to 2,000 A100-hrs for the 14-day window, and a $15k conversion credit if they sign a 12-mo commit within 30 days. Need deal desk / finance OK. @margot can you weigh in?

margot: need a couple of numbers before i can greenlight: projected ARR if they convert, assumed committed term, and our unit cost assumption. if the post-discount margin goes below our threshold we can't approve. paste the quick calc here and i'll run it.

ana: conversion ask from sales: 36k A100-hrs/yr (~3k/mo) as a starter commit; target ARR ~ $1.2M. Term = 12mo. I'll include the conversion incentive in the pitch.

carla: SalesOps: we can generate a POC addendum w/ these bullets:
- dates: explicit start/end for 14 days
- baseline reserved: 400 A100-hr/mo (billed per month pro rata)
- burst cap: 2,000 A100-hrs (hard cap for POC)
- burst discount: 20% off published burst rate during POC window
- conversion credit: $15,000 applied if customer signs 12mo commit within 30 days
- billing fallback: if cap reached, stop burst and notify customer
I'll draft and tag legal. @liam review after draft.

deploy-bot: Capacity-check: region=us-west, reserved pool available for POC window = 4,800 A100-hrs. Autoscale policy validated. No conflicts with scheduled maintenance.

liam: thanks. margot, if you can do conditional finance approval (subject to margin calc + legal signoff) i'll open the deal desk ticket with code: POC-KESTREL-1871 and attach the addendum draft.

margot: conditional approve. Conditions: 1) margin >= our POC threshold (i'll confirm in the ticket), 2) addendum includes hard cap + billing fallback, 3) legal signs. if any condition fails we revert to standard burst billing. approving the discount for the 14-day window once those are met.

ana: great — i'll loop legal + customer, share the draft here. thx team :thumbsup:
